package probe

import "os/exec"

// The exemption is an allow-list: after the subcommand, every literal argument
// that starts with - must be one of -trimpath, -o and -deps. A -ldflags that
// names another linker and its -extld, a -C that runs the go command elsewhere
// and a -pgo that reads a profile are none of them, so each call loses the
// exemption and is refused at its run (P4).

func toolchainLdflagsEqual() error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-ldflags=-linkmode=external -extld=/tmp/x", "./cmd/x")
	return build.Run()
}

func toolchainLdflagsApart() error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-ldflags", "-linkmode=external -extld=/tmp/x", "./cmd/x")
	return build.Run()
}

func toolchainChdir() error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-C", "..", "./cmd/x")
	return build.Run()
}

func toolchainPGO() error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-pgo=x", "./cmd/x")
	return build.Run()
}
